notes.title: ContractVille's First DLC is Now Available! - Update 1.3 & Weekend Sale
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="Zrt7WkNmIDE;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hello Contractors!
We’re excited to bring you ContractVille’s very first Downloadable Content (DLC)!

A brand-new medieval-themed district has been built north of Creek Harbour, ready for you to explore. 

In this DLC you will: ⚒️ Meet a unique character straight from the pages of history, 🏠 Take on a special mission to decorate a Medieval-style house.

🎥 Don’t miss the trailer we’ve prepared for this release!
👉 Visit the DLC Page and start your new adventure today.

We've added a few pieces of furniture to the game that you can try out even if you don't purchase the DLC.

You can access all items included in the DLC by selecting Medieval from the top tab in the furniture stores.

A brand-new road has been added to the city! 🚧 This path will lead you straight to the exciting new contents.

Thanks to the poll we ran on our Discord server, we learned that the most requested theme is Japanese. Taking your feedback to heart, we’ve already begun working on it.

⚔️ After the Medieval DLC, the next big content update will be the Japanese! 🌸


Weekend Sale
We're celebrating ContractVille's first DLC with a Weekend Sale. You can take advantage of a 25% discount from now until the end of the weekend.

Now's the perfect time to jump in—or to gift it to a fellow contractor.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"][/dynamiclink]
Update 1.3
Some books, tables, chairs, coffee tables, kitchen sets, cabinets, bookshelves, beds, and more than just the medieval theme is now available for free with this update. You can buy these from furniture stores.

You can now scroll through the mission information in the upper left corner of the mission houses using the Page Up and Page Down keys.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/e6d7834fa1219a33d8a9193ca291c08fe2c02018.gif"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3969000/ContractVille__Medieval"][/dynamiclink]
Step into an age of knights, lords, and wandering bards, armed with more than 190 authentic furnishings to shape your masterpiece. Every item has been crafted to capture the spirit of medieval life:
Beds for weary travelers, wardrobes for noble attire, benches for gatherings, elegant rugs, sturdy tables, shelves lined with books, and glowing chandeliers that cast light on stone walls.

Rustic cabinets, carved cupboards, long feasting tables, stools and chairs for banquets, shelves stacked with food, and more than 26 unique medieval kitchen tools to prepare a feast fit for a king.

A vast collection of 32 weapons and gear. Swords, shields, bows, crossbows, spears, helmets, axes... Displayed proudly to tell the tale of battles fought and victories won.

With every torch lit and every table set, you shape the story of a bygone age. Create noble halls of grandeur, humble cottages of warmth, or eerie chambers of mystery.
The choice is yours.

Crumbling wells, swings beneath old trees, stone statues, birdcages, signboards, barrels, and firelit torches. Every corner alive with medieval atmosphere! 

Skulls, pots, buckets, candelabras, cradles, laundry boards, crates, bats, and countless small touches that whisper forgotten tales of daily life.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/e86e9ab4f487c8842b29b412ef46c31c8eb4f36e.gif"]

I’d like to remind you that more than 190 new medieval-themed items are waiting to be discovered. With lightable candles and torches, you’ll be able to feel the atmosphere more deeply than ever. 

Our new region, Oathkeeper Mansion, brings a unique color palette that transforms the mood of the game. The moment you step into the mansion, you’ll sense the world shifting into an entirely different tone. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/7aec04458b17d4a699d521ba724b8bab33033eb7.gif"]

This experience is enhanced by enchanting music that beautifully complements the setting. 

And there’s more, interactive details breathe new life into the world: cook meals at a fire pit, draw water from a well, and try your hand at a traditional butter churn.

notes.content:
[previewyoutube="LbyPZ3-poI8;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hello Contractors!

We're back with another exciting update as we continue to build ContractVille in line with our roadmap. This time, we're rolling out important bug fixes along with two major additions: the Pool and the Garage!

To celebrate this milestone, ContractVille is 50% off as part of the ContractVille Daily Deal!
Now's the perfect time to jump in—or to gift it to a fellow contractor.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"][/dynamiclink]

🎥 Don’t forget to check out the video we’ve prepared for this update!

We’ve put it together to give you a closer look at what’s new.



Let’s dive into the full update notes...


Pool
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/5f75c605086452157b727324ed5b0ff7095e2642.gif"]
🏊 A Summer Touch to Your Garden
Bring some summer vibes to your builds!

With the new Pool feature, you can now add a refreshing touch to the garden of your house in ContractVille. Whether you're going for a cozy backyard or a luxurious villa, the pool is the perfect detail to complete your design.

This new feature allows more customization for outdoor spaces and adds a seasonal, decorative element to your houses.

These are ornamental pools, not for swimming, but perfect for elevating the atmosphere of your outdoor spaces. And that’s not all:
We’ve also added a variety of decoration items specially designed for your pool areas!

From life buoys and sun loungers to umbrellas and more, you can now fully customize the look and feel of your poolside. Whether you're going for a relaxing retreat or a vibrant summer setup, the choice is yours.

Just like balconies and porches, pools come in three sizes: small, medium, and large. Pick the one that best fits your plot!
💡 Tip: Don’t forget to leave space for your pool when designing your layout in the planner.

Once you've made your choice, you’ll see exactly how much space it occupies, making it easier to plan ahead.
And of course, as with all ContractVille features, the Pool is fully customizable. Choose your favorite pattern, decide on a color, and build the pool that best matches your design vision.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/845f239b6a9cca9797fea387df7208ad3cdec0fd.gif"]


Garage
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/2aa6e632354a92f21fd126a4a9a9486b55e3f796.gif"]
🚗 Your Car Deserves a Home Too
Add a Garage next to your house and give your vehicles the space they deserve!

Just like the Pool, garages come in three sizes —small, medium, and large— so you can pick the one that best suits your plot.
💡 Make sure to plan ahead in the planner—your garage will need dedicated space next to your house.

As always, the Garage is fully customizable. Choose the type and color that fits your build style. Whether you're going for a clean and modern look or something more rugged, it’s all up to you.

And of course, we didn’t stop there—this update also brings a variety of garage-themed decoration items!
From shelves, ladders, and trash cans to tires, a lifting jack, air tank, fuel tank, and stools, there are plenty of ways to give your garage that authentic, lived-in feel.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/cee5276f55299065cad85ad77462225dac6f9e94.gif"]



In addition to the Pool and Garage update, this patch also brings a meaningful improvement to NPC Workers.


🧱 NPC Workers Now Think Ahead
Your feedback matters, and this one’s for all of you who’ve asked for smoother workflows!

From now on, NPC Workers no longer wait for a manual command to start the next job.
Once you hire an NPC Worker and assign them to build, they’ll automatically move on to the next task without needing additional input from you.

We’ve listened to your requests and hope this change makes your building process more seamless and enjoyable.
Smarter workers, smoother builds!


🔧 And There’s More…
Alongside smarter task handling, we’ve made several additional improvements to NPC Workers:

Reduced NPC Worker Costs by 60%
Hiring help is now more affordable than ever—making it easier to grow your team early on.

Improved Softlock Detection
NPCs now respond better when stuck, thanks to an updated softlock check system. (Includes automatic movement checks on timers for smoother recovery.)

Clearer Notification Sounds
We've added more understandable and context-appropriate audio cues—like grunt sounds—to help you catch issues more intuitively.

Door and Window Assembly
Yes, they finally do it! NPC Workers can now install doors and windows during construction.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello Contractors!

Following the 1.1 update, we have focused on the errors you mentioned and are quickly applying an update. These patch notes also list the bug fixes implemented in version 1.1. As always, we continue to prioritize your bug reports and work to ensure you have a smooth experience.

Before moving on to Bug Fixes, I would like to remind you of our ongoing Summer Sale and giveaway.

Now is the perfect time to step into the world of ContractVille and invite your friends to help you with your construction projects to take advantage of a 40% discount!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"][/dynamiclink]If you would like to participate in our ongoing giveaway to celebrate the Steam Summer Sale and our upcoming update: ContractVille Giveaway 


Major Fixes (Today’s Highlights)
NPCs Could Corrupt Paint Data
An issue where NPCs could unintentionally corrupt paint state (due to Save & Load or other factors) has been resolved.

Wallpaper & Wallboard Coverage Issues 
Fixed multiple cases where doors and parts of certain walls were not covered properly by wallpapers or wallboards. (We are investigating the cause of a bug that causes interaction loss between interior doors that are placed too close to each other. This may still cause problems.)

Navigation Causing FPS Drops 
Resolved a performance issue where the navigation system (particularly pathfinding) led to significant FPS drops. We will continue our efforts to improve navigation.

Woodframe Placement Blockers
Fixed several edge cases where woodframes could not be placed during construction due to invisible or misaligned blockers.

NPC Tutorial Reliability
The NPC tutorial system is now functioning more reliably. A bug that caused empty NPC names to appear and their animations to loop endlessly has been resolved.

Interior Wall Cladding Visibility
The problem of part of the cladding not being visible when cladding interior walls has been solved.

Sliding Door & Archway Mission Compatibility
The compatibility of sliding doors and archways with mission needs has been adjusted.

Old Interior Walls Reappearing After Replanning
A bug that caused interior walls from an old plan to reappear after replanning has been fixed.
[hr][/hr]🧱 General Fixes & Improvements🎨 Efficiency & Material Usage
Paint Efficiency Not Applying: Paint consumption now correctly scales with efficiency levels. Previously, all levels used the same amount.

Plaster Efficiency Level 5 Not Working: Fixed an issue where level 5 plaster efficiency offered no improvement.

NPC Worker Cement Overuse: NPC workers now use cement at rates similar to the player’s, resolving large discrepancies in material consumption.
🚗 Vehicles & Visual Glitches
Client/Server Wheel Sync Issues: Wheels disappearing after Save/Load, Alt + Tab, or reconnecting has been fixed.

Apex Titan X6 Handbrake Animation: Driver hand animation now behaves correctly when using the handbrake.

Apex Titan X6 Engine Toggle Glitch: Fixed a visual bug where wheels would "jump" when rapidly starting/stopping the engine.

FOV Slider Terrain Artifacts: FOV values above 85 no longer cause terrain deformation or visual artifacts.
🔍 UI, Labels & Sorting
Bed Sorting Not Working: Sorting beds by price now works properly in the store UI.

Subtitles Toggle Not Functioning: Subtitles now hide correctly when the setting is turned off.

Planner Typos: "Informations" corrected to "Information"; extraneous strings in Total and Room Info removed.

“Extra Shelfs” Label Fixed: Renamed to "Extra Shelves" for grammatical consistency.
🛏️ Mission & Object Interaction
Joshua Contract Wall Element Count: Corrected a logic error where unremovable baseboards and crown molding were included in the objective count.

Stairs Causing Stuttering: Stuttering related to certain stair types in build missions has been resolved.

Door Invert Screw Bug: Screws on inverted doors are now accessible for tightening and removal.

Wall Demolition Visuals (NPC Workers): NPCs now produce proper demolition visuals, matching those of the player.
[hr][/hr]👷 NPC Worker Fixes🧭 Pathfinding & Task Management
Transport Vehicle Navigation Failures: Vehicles now properly deliver and pick up NPC workers across all mission zones.

Rural Delivery Failures: Delivery vehicles now correctly reach rural areas such as Parcel 1 and Parcel 6.

Gate Detection at Barracks: Barracks gate now opens for NPC workers as expected.

"Move There" to Sky Glitch: Issuing move commands while looking at the sky no longer causes erratic movement.

Send Back to Office Glitch: NPC workers can now be recalled during active tasks, and vehicle behavior has been stabilized.

Duplicate Site Assignments: Reassigning a worker to a site they're already at no longer spawns extra vehicles or causes disappearances.

Reset Issues: Resetting NPCs no longer results in them getting stuck in signage or environment objects.
📦 Task Execution & Visual Sync
Floating Boxes After Save/Load: Boxes held by NPCs are no longer left floating or non-interactable after loading a game.

Furniture Removal Animation Bug: NPCs now properly place boxes instead of throwing them, preventing desync and collision issues.

Client Picking Up NPC Items: Clients can no longer grab items held by NPCs, resolving glitching and stuck-state issues.

Incorrect Objective Label: “Extract” renamed to “Take Out” for consistency with actual objectives.

Tablet UI Shows Idle NPCs: NPC status on the tablet now updates correctly when given tasks from both server and client.

Brick Phase Skipped: Multiple NPCs can now work together without skipping bricklaying before lintel installation.

Transport Vehicle Clipping: Collision with NPC vehicles has been corrected to prevent clipping through them.
👁️ Client & Server Sync
NPC Movement Lag (Client View): NPCs now move smoothly from the client’s point of view.

Client Employee UI Access: Clients can now hire and assign NPCs from the Employee tab like the server player.

Cement Pouring VFX: Cement visuals now appear correctly at the NPC worker’s position instead of in front of the server.

Naming UI Keybind Conflicts: Renaming NPC workers no longer opens conflicting UI tabs.
🛠️ Customization
Office Storage Camera Angle: Adjusted the camera angle during “Extra Shelves” customization to avoid visual obstruction.
🔆 Environment & Lighting
Office Lights Always On: Lights now automatically turn off during daytime, reducing unnecessary brightness.



 Many minor bug fixes were implemented. 

 Many minor visual bugs have been fixed. 

 We continue to fix and work on Crash bugs.

notes.title: ContractVille Full Release Now Available
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VMT1QKgHDao;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello dear contractors!

We have now reached the end of our early access period, which began on May 31, 2024. 
First and foremost, we would like to thank all our players who have supported us from the very beginning and helped us develop ContractVille.
With the Full Release, we would like to inform you that we have renewed the ContractVille brand and our store page and game cover have been renewed. With that, we invite you to watch our Full Release Trailer.

With the release of ContractVille 1.0, we are starting a new beginning. The end of this early access period marks the beginning of a new era. We will continue to improve ContractVille and try to fulfill your wishes.

With version 1.0, we are introducing NPC Workers. We will continue to improve this update throughout 2025.

ContractVille completes Full Release with the release discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107

We would like to share with you our Road Map for the remainder of 2025. With your feedback, we’ll keep shaping the future of ContractVille throughout 2025 and beyond.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/2083cd699cf724f5da7077a6dd7295bbe4ab095d.png

We hear your requests and criticisms. We will continue to work hard to bring ContractVille to its full potential. 

In version 1.0, many bugs were fixed. We have completed the NPC Workers update and will continue to improve it. 

NPC Workers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/272ae37790b90d154efc72d42ac9bfaf1c672573.gif

In November 2024 we did a Player's Choice Survey and the most requested update out of the 10 options was NPC Workers. 
We delivered on our promise and NPC Workers is now available in version 1.0!

Get Workers Cabin upgrades from the control panel in your office, then hire workers. Send them to your missions in active missions and lands and let them help you by giving them commands.

We read in the comments of previous announcements that you want workers to bring goods from the warehouse, but as we mentioned there, we think this would disrupt the flow and organization of the game.
We will fulfill this request with the Cargo From Storage update that we mentioned in our roadmap.

If you want to learn more about the NPC Workers update that came with version 1.0, you can read the DevLogs we prepared for them.

Bug Fixes & Improvements

We’ve been hard at work fixing a number of inconsistencies, visual glitches, and multiplayer synchronization issues to enhance your experience. Below is a summary of the most significant changes included in this update:

🏠 Building & Mission Fixes

 Resolved an issue where placeholder houses would revert to default window and door colors instead of preserving player-installed choices after mission completion.
 Fixed a bug causing the “General Progress” bar to incorrectly display 25,500/100 at the start of the Build phase instead of 0/100.
 Exterior Cladding can no longer be installed before reaching the Exterior Work phase, and cladding installed prematurely can now be removed with the Demolish Tool.
 Adjusted Build Mission logic to properly complete the “Clad Exterior Walls” objective when the required amount is exceeded.
 Improved tile placement logic to prevent new tiles from being placed directly over existing tiles, avoiding visual glitches and z-fighting.
 Rug tiling behavior adjusted to prevent rugs from being trapped underneath new tiles during renovation missions.
 Corrected an issue where mission planning and requirement checks continued to use the metric system even when imperial was selected.


🧰 Tools & Animation Enhancements

 Improved texture resolution on newly added “Go Green” tool skins across all tools, particularly for the trashbag, window cleaner, paint roller, plasterer, and screwdriver.
 Fixed an issue where the painting animation would loop indefinitely when attempting to paint with an empty roller (0% paint).
 Snap Mode no longer auto-enables when placing windows while it is disabled.


📦 Trash Compactor Adjustments

 Updated in-game prompts for the Trash Compactor to more accurately reference “non-recycled boxes” instead of “trash.”
 The warning text now reads “You need two non-recycled boxes to compact!” and “Non-recycled box types need to be same!” for improved clarity and consistency.


✉️ Mail & Contract Missions

 Fixed an issue in Mail Mission ID 19 where the progress incorrectly remained at 76% despite only a few tasks remaining. Progress now correctly reflects actual task completion.
 Resolved a missing rug issue in the same mission that prevented full task completion.
 Corrected collision and placement issues causing accessories like toilet paper in ID19 to spawn inside walls, preventing interaction.
 Fixed an issue in ID33 Lin Decorate Contract where guest room tiles and rugs could not be interacted with.
 Adjusted Clean Water Campaign logic to allow retrieval of boxes even if the ghost overlaps during the wooden plank phase.
 Fixed an issue where Whoopie Cushions (formerly Fart Bombs) would become invisible or irretrievable when placed behind specific vehicles.


🏭 Factory & Item Behavior

 Improved interaction logic for the Advanced Factory panels to prevent repeated activation after the progress bar passes 80%.
 Corrected the visual and logic behavior of coupon payments even when panel progress appears stuck.
 Fixed a bug where aborted Build Missions could still allow digging during the planning phase.
 Trash Compactor logic now accurately reflects the required material types and avoids misidentifying materials.


🎨 Visual & Save/Load Fixes

 Ceiling paint now correctly saves and loads across sessions, preventing ceilings from reverting to white.
 Low-resolution thumbnails in the Hardware Store have been addressed for various items including roof tiles, gables, chimneys, and roof windows.
 Resolved visual glitch allowing mission house furniture to be pushed inside exterior walls, causing progress blockers.


🚚 Vehicle & Physics Fixes

 Fixed a bug where placing Non-Recycled Boxes on top of tires in a vehicle trunk caused vehicles to float upon entering the driver seat.
 Corrected issue with the trolley becoming immovable when overloaded with mission items and used near stairs.
 Prevented player vehicles from spawning in the air due to save/load conflicts with NPC vehicle spawn points.


📦 Store & Multiplayer Consistency

 The “Return All” function now works correctly for clients in multiplayer sessions.
 Store sales are now synchronized between server and client, including sale prices, in-store displays, and promotional emails.
 Resolved crash issue when combining a \$5 item with max-stock decoration items in the cart during a sale, preventing a stack overflow error.
 Online Store thumbnails for Contract Build Missions now correctly show the mission-specific image instead of the default Cargo Point thumbnail.
 Improved item need tracking in the Mission Needs tab, ensuring accessory types are accurately counted regardless of variation.


🪟 Windows & Cladding

 Fixed incorrect screw placements on windows near staircases, ensuring screws appear on the correct (interior) side.
 Resolved an issue where old windows would remain on the parcel even after demolition and repurchase of the same lot.


🔊 Sound & Effects

 Aborting Logistics or Mail Missions no longer triggers the “Mission Complete” SFX or “Vehicle Not Found” warnings.
 Resolved an SFX bug where the sound of filling a generator persisted even after the generator was moved away from the fuel source.



 Many minor bug fixes were implemented.
 Many minor visual bugs have been fixed.
 We continue to fix and work on Crash bugs.

notes.title: NPC Workers - DevLog #2
notes.content:
Hello Contractors!
We're back once again with the ContractVille developer diary.
As you know, in our previous announcements, we announced that we will introduce NPC Workers with Full Release. 
We are very close to Full Release and we wanted to share the latest status of NPC Workers with you. 
We will announce our roadmap after Full Release very soon. Exciting new features are waiting for you!
Before we move on to the NPC Workers DevLog, I would like to emphasize that the following are not the final versions that will be available to you and that mechanics and visuals are subject to change.

NPC Workers - Breaking News!
In DevLog #1, we mentioned that the UI is not ready yet, it has not been updated. In this article, I would like to inform you that the UI has been updated.
You can hire your workers by going to Employees in the Company app on your tablet. 
As we mentioned in DevLog #1, this section will only be available when you get the Worker Cabins upgrades in your office. 
You will pay NPC Workers a daily wage, which will increase according to their level. Their level affects their work speed.
You will be able to select the employee you hire and send them to available lands and missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/174c90054fe1f306477c64e60d123c2d19f02f87.gif

In DevLog #1 we mentioned that the office will now have a second entrance and exit area. And in our latest beta version we have now added these paths. NPC Workers will exit their cabins and use this path to get into the waiting vehicle.
It also means that you can now leave the office and go straight to the recycling factory.
After a few seconds, the vehicle picking up the workers will drop them off at their posts and they will be ready to work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/7725dace72b2b75396e13191870ea7d3323c3849.gif

You can select and command workers in the workspace by pointing at them with your finger. After selecting a worker with your finger, show him the work he wants to do. 
In DevLog #1 we showed that workers can demolish. This time you will see them working on a construction site. You can have them complete a construction from start to finish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/cfeed404bd970c8e148267d3785c2cc1f105ef98.gif

You can also have workers collect garbage. In some cases it is much easier to pick up the garbage they leave behind.🤣
In many ways, we think NPC Workers will bring a new level of fun and plenty of funny moments to ContractVille.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/df6991767396b18f6db4e2a70cf1b61525adc246.gif

We remember when making cement was a pain for you. Following your criticism, we enlarged the cement machine and presented it to you as Mortar Mixer Level II. We also introduced a larger version of the cement packs.
After all these, now NPC Workers will be able to do the cement work for you, which will be a great convenience for our players who play ContractVille especially alone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/8037f2c884e8856999dbfa5a18fb517458ee6c8b.gif

It is very pleasant and relaxing to watch them pour the cement. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/c0680339ad60b22036c57b72ddd6f12461dff136.gif

We would like to say that you should buy all the materials they need. And in the current version they use the materials more than you will. We think that the workers steal the materials and use them for other things.  Well... Of course, it could be because we haven't set it up yet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/b1f45a0e54d3b5533f152a7748d6b06d172fae89.gif

In the current beta version, level 3 workers lay the bricks in threes and fives. And when you're working on a small plot of land, it gets done pretty fast! 
Of course, it must be said that the daily wage of a level 5 worker can be a hefty price. In the example below you can see 3 level 3 workers laying all the bricks in less than 1 minute.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/4015bed0a824b3aaa2634a087cf95eccead457d9.gif

As at the end of DevLog #1, I would like to end this article by showing you a bug.
An NPC worker throws a box away for no reason! 
Just one of the issues to be resolved before we present it to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/d4cd3f16c3267a84e955cee14e5b8b724f03b6d1.gif

We continue to fix a lot of bugs with NPC Workers, such as problems with their navigation, headbutting boxes, getting stuck in some places and not doing what is asked correctly, and we have fixed many of the previous ones. We can't wait to complete the improvements and release the full version.
You can rest assured that our testing team goes through all the processes in detail to ensure you have the best experience. And as always, we will take your criticism and suggestions about NPC Workers into consideration after the Full Release.
After the release, we will have a channel on our Discord server where you can write about everything related to NPC Workers.

Thank you very much for following us and reading this post.
Lots of love to our players who support us! 💙

notes.title: Update 0.9 - Openable Curtains
notes.content:
Hello Contractors!
In this update, we've addressed a wide range of issues reported by our players and testers, aiming to improve both the stability and consistency of gameplay across all systems. From visual inconsistencies to multiplayer synchronization fixes, this patch resolves key problems and enhances the overall experience. As we approach ContractVille version 1.0, we continue to focus on bugs.

Following the Openable Windows update, we're adding one more addition to the windows and introducing Openable Curtains.

Openable Curtains
Now you can open and close the curtains too! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/3492b9a30befac35cf3610c99558187416b70599.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107

Bug Fixes
🛠️ General Item & Visual Fixes

 Material Swap Issue Resolved: Changing the seat material of the makeup table no longer affects the mirror material.
 Incorrect Materials and Textures Fixed: Several items that displayed incorrect materials or textures—both in previews and after placement—now appear as expected.
 Painting Mix-up Resolved: In some paintings, there were cases where the picture did not match the purchased products. This problem is now fixed.


🪟🪟 Openable Window Fixes

 Texture & Color Mismatch Fixed: Openable parts of windows now match the frame's texture and color instead of using defaults.
 Screw Interaction Logic Updated: Screws on openable windows can no longer be removed while the window is open, preventing softlocks.
 Tint Consistency Restored: Openable window panes are now transparent like their non-openable counterparts.
 Interaction Bug Fixed: Openable windows are no longer interactable after house sale or mission completion.
 Client-Side Positioning Fixed: Reinstalled windows now appear correctly on both server and client after removal.


🧱 Construction & Mission Fixes

 Broken/Damaged Furniture Visibility Restored: Packed damaged furniture in Decorate missions no longer becomes invisible after saving/loading.
 Hardware Store Interactions Improved: Interacting with store items in Demolish missions no longer requires precise edge alignment.
 Ceiling Gap Visual Issue Fixed: Gaps between ceilings and interior walls in top-floor rooms have been addressed.
 Localization Issue Fixed: The “One Brick At A Time” quest now shows the proper equipment list instead of a placeholder message for clients.


🚪 Doors, Stairs & Tiles

 Subbasement Tiling Standardized: The subbasement stairs can now be tiled consistently with proper pattern alignment.
 Tile Gap Resolved: Lin Decorate hallway tiles now appear properly and no longer leave a visible gap (visual-only issue).
 Stair Rug Customization Bug Fixed: L type stair's materials have been arranged to make it work more properly.


🚗 Vehicles & UI Improvements

 Fuel Value Exploit Fixed: Saving while inside a car no longer restores fuel to above half on load.
 Unit System Consistency: Speed display now respects the chosen metric/imperial system in vehicle purchase panels.
 Taxi Pickup Bug Resolved: A passenger near the Airport area can now be picked up as expected.
 Multiplayer Max Player Selector Fixed: Decreasing player count from 4 no longer incorrectly jumps to 2 instead of 3.
 Bank UI Overflow Addressed: Scrolling in the bank panel no longer causes visual overflow at the top or bottom.
 Inventory Warning Updated: Trolley now correctly shows "Inventory is Full!" even when partially filled with smaller boxes.
 Typo Fixed: "Transfere Inventory" is now correctly labeled as "Transfer Inventory".


🏡 Parcel & Property Fixes

 Built House Disappearance Fixed: Houses built on parcels no longer vanish after saving and loading when they go up for sale.
 Gardening Updates Applied: Numerous inconsistencies with garden mechanics have been resolved.


👤 Character & Gameplay Fixes

 Name Display Sync Fixed: Character name changes now immediately update above the player without needing extra triggers.
 Speed Skill Calculation Fixed: Speed Skill is now working correctly, as it should. Whether you run or walk, you will be as fast as you increase your speed skill! 
 Floating Bug in Camera Mode Resolved: Cement buckets no longer float or appear empty when held in camera mode.
 Duplicate Blinds Placement Bug Fixed: Installing new window blinds now requires removing old broken ones to properly progress "Take Out Furniture" steps.


🏢 Environment & Visual Polish

 Office Garage Label Corrected: “Billboard Table” has been corrected to “Billiard Table,” or “Pool Table” for consistency with the in-game item.
 Poster Area Bug in Public Awareness Campaign 4 Fixed: Poster locations no longer disappear from the minimap while inside the mission area.
 Fixed visual bugs across the city.


🎨 Additional Audio & Label Fixes

 Crown Molding/Baseboard SFX Swapped Back: Installation sounds now play correctly for both molding and baseboards.
 UI Text Consistency Polished.
 Some localizations have been improved.

Having given you this important news...

After the major updates such as Garden, Roof & Porch and Roofless Porch, we think that the balcony is a great complement to the look of a house. With this balcony update, one more thing has been added and now the houses you build look even better! 
If you're curious about what's ahead for ContractVille, you can check the "What's New?, In Development, Planned" section from the main menu.

Balcony

French Balcony

 French-style (flush with the wall)
 Roofed (covered top for extra structure and visual depth)
 Open/roofless (for a lighter, more minimal look)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/225d2a5d7ec111b5b740bbeeb51eb48e0735ad37.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/fa305da78b4779f05fbf6386756c0699056af9a4.gif

 🛠️ Bug Fixes

Trolley Spawn Position Fixed
 Fixed an issue where taking control of the trolley caused it to appear to the right side of the character instead of in front. The trolley now spawns in the correct position when picked up.

Scott Mail Bathroom Tiling Overspill
 Fixed a tiling issue in the Scott Mail mission where tiles could be placed slightly beyond the bathroom door frame, preventing placement in adjacent rooms.

Resolution Lock in Borderless Fullscreen
 Fixed an issue where Borderless Fullscreen mode would incorrectly detect resolution from GPU scaling options like DSR or FSR.
The game now correctly uses your desktop's native resolution when Borderless Fullscreen is selected.

Achievement Text Clarification
 Updated the description of the "Logistics Baron" achievement to remove misleading language about "cargo," and capitalized mission names for clarity.

Excessive Tiling Requirement in Ivan Mission
 Adjusted the "Tile the Floor" objective in the Ivan Build mission. It now reflects the correct required area, even in rooms without separating interior walls.

Missing Text for Amid
 Fixed a missing text issue for Amid, where the comment was replaced by a  placeholder.

Hallway Task Progress Blocked
 Resolved an issue where hallway progress would not update correctly. Tasks like painting or plastering now reflect properly and allow stage progression.

Player Marker Color Not Updating
 Fixed an inconsistency where changing the player marker color wouldn’t update the in-game head marker until reentering a vehicle or rejoining the session.

Server Crash on Eating Buff End
 Fixed a server crash that occurred when the eating buff ended after a client-side food interaction glitch.

Stuck Cargo Points in Go Green Missions
 Addressed an issue where cargo points from completed “Go Green” missions (Green City Initiative & Clean Water Campaign) remained in the game world. These are now removed correctly upon mission completion.

Imperial Speed Display Mismatch
 Corrected a display bug where the vehicle speed in imperial units appeared inconsistent with the actual numerical value.

Refund Price Bug with Sweet Talk Skill
 Fixed a bug where returning discounted items while the “Sweet Talk” skill was active refunded the full original price instead of the actual purchase price.

Recycle Trolley Query Display Bug
 Fixed an issue where recycle boxes taken by trolley caused the visible query number of paper and metal trash to display as 0.

Stacking Recycled Boxes Resets Queue
 Addressed a bug where repeatedly throwing recycled boxes on top of others in front of the bin caused the queue count to reset to 0.

notes.title: Update 0.7.1 - Roofless Porch & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello contractors!
With this update we are adding to the Roof & Porch update and continuing bug fixes. Over the past 1 week, we've seen that you've really liked this update and we're happy about that. We've been reading your suggestions and we've got a few improvements for you to enjoy.
Before we talk about those, I'd like to announce that we'll be holding a giveaway in honor of our Discord server reaching 10k members. 
Discord 10.000 Member Celebration
Our community continues to grow by the day and we would like to thank everyone who is a part of it! Our Discord server has reached 10k members. 
In honor of this milestone, we will be hosting a giveaway on our Discord server. To participate in this giveaway, all you need to do is join our Discord server and visit the #events channel.

Let's get started...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107

Roofless Porch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/8075d85c6a05f384000f63db4a7595468ee76586.png

We thought that porches don't always need a roof and that beautiful designs can be created with just the base, and we present the roofless porch to you with this update. We hope you like it as a novelty to beautify your garden.

Replacing Roof Tiles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/eef11bc2a72ae9142ae0f0aff1f46bf67984d9a7.png

Don't like the color of your roof? Tear it down and re... No. Now you can change it with just one click! You can change your roof with just a different Roof Tile box. This also allows you to make different designs. 

Distant City Details
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/656f20c6827f4b8743baf897ffb4ffb6df8cc175.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/76dbef0185d23fe7803642e5f0c2a96c44241cbf.png

When you look away from Creek Harbour, you can now see other cities. When it gets dark, you can see the lights of distant cities. These details are designed to make the world of ContractVille more realistic.

Some Furniture Revised

We changed the materials of some of the furniture and added more details, so you can customize the colors of the body and details as you wish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/9c48d3e311a9e35b93cceaee3703ba7a7e88f68a.png

Bug Fixes

Roof Fixes & Improvements

 Snap-able Roofs: Gable Roofs can now be snapable. This feature, which was available on HIP Roofs, is now also available for Gable Roofs. In this way, it is possible to make more different designs.
 Multi-Story Roof Placement Fix: Roofs can now only be placed on the topmost floor of multi-story buildings.
 Roof Build Mission Completion Fix: Roof Windows and Chimneys no longer disappear when accepting the same Build Mission again.
 Gable Roof Beam Collision Fix: The edge beams of Gable Roofs now have accurate collision and visual alignment.
 Roof Builder (GABLE) Length Adjustment Fix: On GABLE type roofs the length of the sides can now be adjusted by the player.
 Roof Chimney Sound Effects Added: Installation and demolition of Roof Chimneys now include proper sound effects.
 Roof Snapping Alignment Fix: Roofs now correctly snap to adjacent roofs during Placement Mode when properly aligned.
 Floating Roof Placement Fix: Roofs can no longer be placed in the air when the Roof Builder is activated outside the Roof Area.
 Roof Dimension Limitations Implemented: Roof height adjustments are now restricted within reasonable limits, while length remains bound to the building plan.
 Roof Consumable Usage Synchronization: When a roof-related consumable item is used, the server now correctly updates the item’s remaining amount.
 Roof Height Modification Restriction After Snap: Once a Roof is snapped into place, its height and length can no longer be adjusted beyond the dimensions of the connected Roof.
 Gable Roof Area Extension Fix: The Gable Roof can no longer be extended excessively beyond the designated Roof Area. Additionally, Roof Ends now align correctly without unintended angling issues.
 Roof Builder Snap Dimension Alignment Fix: Roofs now retain consistent height and length when snapped together, preventing mismatches and ensuring a visually and structurally uniform appearance.
 Fixing the Appearance of HIP Roofs: Fixed a bug with HIP roofs where the tiles on each side did not look the same.

General Fixes

 Polish Language Update: We have made many fixes in Polish and we would like to thank our dear players who helped us with this on our Discord server and Gluciorek who single-handedly made hundreds of fixes. We also had a lot of Polish players willing to help and we thank them all for their offers. Dziękuję!
 Classport Nimo Fuel Cap Fix: The problem with not being able to interact with the refueling point when interacting with the pump or gas canister to refuel the vehicle has been resolved.
 City Furniture Store Lampshade Thumbnail Fix: Low-resolution lampshade thumbnails have been updated to match their in-game quality.
 Box Placement Restrictions Updated: Players will no longer be able to place boxes on the heads of other players and stationary NPCs in the world.
 Parcel Sign Interaction Fix: Parcel signs now correctly display only the intended parcel information, preventing unintended interactions with newly listed parcels.
 General improvements: Many improvements have been made in terms of optimization and visuals and SFX.
 Minor bug fixes have been implemented.

Environmental & World Fixes

 Underground Trash in Office Area: Repositioned two underground trash items that were uncollectable and corrected floating/clipping trash in the Office area.

Garden Fixes

 In demolish missions, missing or miscounted furniture items no longer block mission completion. @coder2000 via Discord
 For missions allowing any chosen paint color, the purchased color now correctly appears crossed out in the Mission Needs list.  @Tom | xRetroWave via Discord

 The client planner no longer causes the Planner’s cabin to become a “Ghost” state, which previously prevented construction.

Vehicles and Transportation:
[olist]
 Fixed bug where fuel pumps and power plugs could be plugged into the trailer. This bug was also affecting the carrying capacity of the trailer. @Laserian via Steam Discussions

 Fixed a bug where boxes could be taken from underneath another box, resulting in visual stack errors. @Mantauran via Discord

[olist]

Others:

 Fixed a bug where waste could be disposed of in the Compactor.
 Placing a box on a rug no longer causes the rug to disappear. @Mantauran via Discord
 The Water Mill Wheel Box no longer disappears unexpectedly.
 Boxes placed in the office garage no longer disappear when set down.

notes.title: ContractVille Update 0.2.3
notes.content:
Greetings, dear contractors,
In preparation for the Taxi and Cargo update, we've fixed a few more bugs in the game with this update. You should know that we're working hard every day to improve your gaming experience, and thank you again for your patience.
Our next big update, Taxi and Cargo, will be coming in the course of this month. We will publish an announcement about this in the coming days.

Improvements

 Players can now easily enter the Nexus Hatch Truck. You can pick up the boxes at ease!
 The sleep time has been adjusted. Wake-up time has been updated to 06.35.
 In logistics missions, tasks can now be completed by interacting with NPCs at both the pickup and delivery locations.
 After upgrading to level 2 in the office building, furniture that appears on the balcony can now be packed and removed.
 Nights are now brighter! Overhaul on lighting
 ContractVille T-shirts and hats have been added. We have a surprise coming soon...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/4faa846b79aecd8ca263bd87e93322bf42b2f981.png


EULA and Privacy Policy

 Added an EULA (End User License Agreement) and Privacy Policy.

The reason we include it is to see your preferences in the game, to see what you like the most and to improve it. We also want to get stats on them so we can use them in future updates.
For legal reasons, we need your permission for this.
If you reject the privacy policy, we will not retain your data.


Bug Fixes

Visual & UI

 Fixed an issue where clothes were not visible in the dressing room.
 Corrected a problem in the "Go Green" missions where task descriptions wouldn't disappear upon completion or continuation.
 Radiators were snapping below the floor when placed under a window. This has been fixed.
 The discount label in German language stores was misaligned. This has been corrected.
 Fixed a problem where boxes displayed duplicate names when hovered over.
 Amid's "easy" contract mission was missing detailed objectives. All objectives are now visible.
Gameplay

 Fixed an issue where homes on land properties would disappear.
 In co-op mode, trash boxes were not spawning when the server was in a vehicle. This has been resolved.
 Fixed a texture issue in the Granite Tile Pack where the appearance didn't match the package image.
 Merchant eyes skill was not giving the full price at level 3. Fixed.
 When the diesel gas canister was installed and removed from the generator in the office, it turned to unleaded. Fixed.
Exploits Fixed

 An exploit that allowed players to obtain multiple coupons in the Factory by rapidly pressing the E key has been fixed.
 Fixed an issue where different exterior claddings could be stacked.
 In all vehicles, fuel refilling would continue even if fuel was added and immediately removed. This has been corrected.
 Fixed a bug where the mixer could take more than its capacity.
Co-op Issues

 Fixed a crash when sending the vehicle to the garage when the client trailer is attached to the vehicle.
 When the client sent the car to the garage, it did not appear on the server. If the server also sent a car to the garage, two cars were overlapping. This is fixed.
 Client could not repaint when motion sickness setting was on on the server in built houses. Fixed.
 Fixed a bug that caused the Gas canister to appear empty in Co-op.
Construction Issues

 Parcel replanning was deleting doors and windows.
 Fixed a bug that caused the color and appearance of built houses to change.

notes.title: ContractVille Update 0.2.2
notes.content:
Hello, dear contractors 
This update focuses on improving overall bug fixes and gameplay improvements to improve the user experience. Thank you for reporting bugs and for your support.

Gameplay Improvements

 NPC Interaction: NPC cars now play horn sounds when hit, enhancing realism and responsiveness in the game.
 Go Green Milestones: Added necessary Go Green XP indicators to milestone elements for clearer progression tracking.
 New Access Point: A back door has been added to the Hardware Store in Port Town.
 Edible Demolition: Food and beverages can now be demolished.
 Trailer Manual Attachment: Players can now move trailers by hands, providing more control over vehicle management.


Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Sound and Character Corrections:


 Fixed an issue where the sound wheel would play male sounds for female characters.
 Addressed bugs related to the replaying of Go Green dialogues. (Public Awareness Campaign)
 Fixed an issue where, in specific scenarios, characters would be teleported to an incorrect location when exiting a vehicle.
 Resolved a bug where NPC vehicles would not play horn sounds upon collision.

 Server and Client Synchronization:


 Resolved an issue where the client-placed alternator was not represented on the server, ensuring proper synchronization.

 Environment and Object Interaction:


 Fixed a problem where characters would be displaced when exiting vehicles under specific scenarios.
 Corrected trolley physics and behavior when interacting with items.

 Map and Object Placement:


 Fixed an issue where the center item on a full trolley would not move down when removed.
 Rectified a problem in construction missions where placed floor materials would have incorrect rotation, causing misalignment.
 Resolved an issue with items dropping beneath the landscape when packaging objects on top of others.
 Fixed issues with Go Green objectives where map markers wouldn’t show upon repeating tasks.

 User Interface and Visuals:

 Adjusted the vehicle dashboard panels for a clearer and more accurate display.
 Ensured proper visibility of items and structures after mission completion and game reload.
 When the construction task was finished, the appearance of the windows and doors we installed was changing. Now they don't change. 
 Corrected a bug that prevented photo mode from closing when saving during a vandal mission. (Justice for Nature)
[/olist]

Stutter Fix

 Fixed stuttering when entering and exiting houses.

Known Issues

 Some pre-existing save files may still have minor visual discrepancies when loading into new updates. Players are encouraged to report any anomalies to the support team for further investigation.

notes.title: ContractVille Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
Dear contractors
We are dedicated to enhancing our service by addressing the bugs and suggestions you have shared with us. We appreciate and consider all the information you provide to us. Following this hotfix, we will remain attentive to your concerns and ideas.

New Languages and Translations
Českým hráčům přejeme příjemnou zábavu a mnoho úspěchů ve hře!

 General translation improvements made.

Time to escape the symphony of chaos!

Bug Fixes and Game Issues

[olist]

 Fixed a bug where map markers for "Go Green" objects did not disappear when the player completed the quest early.
 Corrected an error where recycled objects needed to be placed at the delivery point instead of being thrown into the trash bin for the "Go Green" objectives.

Thanks to all our contractors!
ContractVille Team

notes.title: Big Update: Go Green (ContractVille 0.2 Release)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Eejr7fr2ezw;full][/previewyoutube]

With this major update, we are presenting the Go Green App to you. 6 New mission types and their rewards; such as tool skins, gemstones, trophies, and cabinets where you can display them. Sculptures, Go Green t-shirt, the trailer and trolley you really wanted, and much more!
Additionally, this update includes 3 new mail missions, 9 new contract missions, over 250 new furniture items, foods and beverages, optimization improvements, and environmental arrangements.
Don't forget to follow our game on our Steam Store Page to stay updated on future updates.

Welcome to the Go Green!
ContractVille's Go Green update brings you 6 different mission types to save the environment. 

Go Green App

You will be able to take all missions through the Go Green App on your tablet. You will earn XP from each mission and with the XP you earn, you will complete the Go Green Progress and reach the rewards. 
Remember that you can do Go Green missions as many times as you want!

Achivements!
We've added new achievements exclusive to Go Green, which you can view in the “Achievements” section on Steam and in your in-game profile, which you can access from your tablet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/bc29d8b1df88ad1dd01edf1a35ec0600928b7fb5.jpg

[olist]

 Public Awareness Campaign
Get the city ready for a green revolution! Put up posters, talk to NPCs, and spread your message everywhere. Raise environmental awareness and become the city's hero!
There will be NPCs waiting for you in various areas of the city. Inform them about environmental pollution. For example did you know that a single plastic bottle can take up to 450 years to decompose?
Some of them may snub you and not want to talk to you. But remember, even if one person changes, the world changes.
To reach more people, you will be able to put up posters in certain areas of the city and advertise on certain vehicles in the city!

In this mission, you’ll have new items at your disposal to help green the city: Fertilizer, Gravel, Seed, Soil, Pot, Watering Can, Seedling, Pesticide, and Tree. With your shovel in hand and a little elbow grease, you’ll transform the urban landscape into a thriving green space. Every tree you plant and nurture is a step toward a greener, healthier city.  Volunteer For A Clean Future
Take on the challenge of cleaning up after the city's biggest events!
In this mission we add concert, outdoor market, skating tournament, drive-in cinema, beach party and nightclub venues! Your mission is to rid these dirty spots of trash. Join the volunteer team and make sure the fun doesn't leave a mess behind!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/f9120673d7dd3d8e2e996bb79d8715a571d2c64c.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/272120fb34bf877701eff150fd08b23d1d3c4b6b.jpg


 Forest Revival
Venture into the forests and become a true guardian of nature! Rescue animals trapped in litter, clean up the wilderness, and restore the natural beauty of the forests. This is your chance to witness the wonders of nature as you bring life back to the wild!
To succeed in this mission, your goal is to rescue animals from the filth choking their natural habitat. These poor creatures may be trapped in piles of garbage, struggling to survive. People may have thrown broken and old furnitures into their natural habitat. It is up to you to save them from the clutches of pollution and the cruelty of those who desecrate nature.

Arm yourself with the sword of justice to protect nature! Face off with vandals, defend the environment, and become a hero who saves nature. Stop the bad guys and save the earth!

But stay strong—remember, you’ve got the power of justice on your side, and no one can stand in your way! Keep going, and show them who’s boss! Don't forget to photograph them and send them over to the police to guarantee justice!

Bring cleanliness to the waters and become a hero! Clean the rivers, build water mills, and use the power of water to protect nature. Be the guardian of clean water and protect the future!
In this mission, you must first clean up the garbage on the riverbank. Then you will build a water mill!

notes.title: Contractville 0.0.9 Update
notes.content:
Hello contractors!

We've fixed a lot of bugs in this update thanks to your bug reports, and we'd like to thank you for your support during our early access period. We hope you'll continue to support us and before we get to the update notes...

We invite everyone to our Discord server. Today at 17:00 (GMT+0), we will share an announcement with you on our Discord server. We have a surprise for you. We are sharing the link to our Discord server so that you don't miss this and future surprises.

Sleep Wherever You Want!
New Feature!
Added the ability to sleep on all purchased beds and we removed the existing fixed beds so you can arrange your office room however you like!

Updates to the Planner
New Feature!
Building Plans with the New System
With the new system, you can now easily save and load building plans.

 Automatically saves every 5 minutes in the background. It also autosaves when you complete the planning. The number of autosaves is limited to 5. Apart from this, manual save feature has been added. The number of manual saves is unlimited. 
 Your saves in Planner are not specific to your world. When you join another world, you can use your previously saved plans.
 Plans will be parcel size specific. (For example, if it is a small plot plan, you can only see your save when planning on small plots).
 If you plan a 5-story house and want to use your saved plan while working on a 3-story house, it will load the first 3 floors of the 5 floors on your plan.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/6a1dfc8eb78974b186bdac6d60053629fb8c633a.png
You can also share this file with your friends.
To find your save files, you can copy this: %UserProfile%\AppData\Local\ContractVille\Saved\SaveGames 
Then paste it in the file explorer.
Press enter and the folder with your save files should be opened.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/b839041c84a82d78845268eb2af00a32edd995c8.png

Bug Fixes Planner and Build

 Staircase Template Issue: Fixed an issue that caused the template to remain active after the stairs were placed. The template will now deactivate as expected.
 Ground and Upper Floors Issue: Fixed an issue where the upper floors would reset after changes to the ground floor at planner; these floors will now retain their structure.
 Hotkeys: Fixed the issue that disabled buttons could be accesed by hotkeys at planner.
 Planner Undo/Redo Fix: 

 If no changes have been made in the planner yet, Undo/Redo buttons have been disabled. 
 When a new change is made, the Redo button becomes disabled. 
 If there are no changes to undo, the Undo button is also disabled.

 Missing Walls Issue: We've fixed bugs that in some cases caused the walls of built houses to disappear. We've fixed all the issues we've identified so far, but be aware that this problem may persist in different scenarios. We continue to monitor and fix this issue.
 Interior Wall Placement Error: Fixed a bug where interior walls at planner could be placed with a single click where they shouldn't be.
 Floor Count Confusion at Planner: Resolved the issue that caused confusion regarding the floor tallies of land properties. Floor counts are now accurately represented.
 Objective Tracking: 
 The issue that prevented window and door placement objectives from being counted in build missions has been resolved. All objectives will now be tracked correctly.
 
 Fixed the issue where tile floor objectives generated in stair areas at build missions

Physics and Object Improvements

 Moving Object Physics: Fixed an issue where objects would activate their physics when placed under another object. Objects will no longer move.
 Empty Gas Can Issue: Fixed an issue where interacting with the empty gas canister connected to the generator in the office would cause the player to interact with the gas canister if they were holding another object.

Character and Animation Updates

 Character Creation Spotlight: A spotlight has been added to the character creation area for better visibility in night scenarios.
 Female Face Type Fix: Female face types had two options with the same type. One of these options has been removed.
 Animation Cancellation: When you take plaster from the plaster bucket to the trowel and at the same time turn to the wall and start plastering, the previous animation will be canceled.
 Barber Chair Animation: 
 Fixed bugs in the barber chair animation. This animation will now run smoothly.
 Also, it has been prevented that the person setting up the server and the person joining the game can sit at the same time. 
 Getting up from the seat was repeating the animation twice for the participating player. We fixed this.
 Fixed a bug where the sitting animation isn't playing for the participating player for a large percentage of the time, and when it is, the participating player is siting on the sink instead of the seat.

Skill Errors

 Demolition Skill Upgrade: Fixed an issue where the Demolition Speed upgrade was not active at some levels. Also fixed an issue where some skill attributes were blank when the skill set was reset.
 Glass Cleaner Skill: Fixed an issue where the clear area bonus for the glass cleaner skill was not increasing from level 2 to level 3.
 Unupgradable Skills: Fixed an issue where some skill attributes could not be upgraded after a skill set reset.
System and Functionality Improvements
[olist]  Sleeping Time: Sleep time now starts at 20:00 instead of 19:42.
 Radio System Repair: The radio system has been reorganized to fix various issues, improving overall functionality and stability. The radio now works smoothly.
 Cole Building Mission: The tablet mission description will now correctly display “Luxury Points”, which was missing for some furniture.
 Skilled Master Achievement: Fixed the issue that was preventing players from earning the "Skilled Master" achievement.
 Multiplayer Cargo Placement: Resolved inconsistencies with cargo placement in multiplayer mode, ensuring smoother interactions.
 Movement Key Issue: Fixed the issue that caused the player to become stuck moving after pressing movement keys during the loading screen.
 Parked Car Trunks: Resolved an issue where trunks were moving parked cars unexpectedly.
 Generator Warning: Fixed the issue where the generator was giving a "wrong fuel type" warning when using an empty gasoline canister.
 Face Type Button Focus: Fixed an issue in the character creation screen where the camera was moving while hovering over the "face type" button.
 Participant Player Night Light Bug: Fixed bugs related to lights not being on when the client joins the game at night. Street lights and some buildings now work properly for the client who joins the game.
 Third Person Camera: Fixed camera view issues in third-person mode while driving with an object in the trunk.
 Light Switch Interaction Text: Changed the interaction text from "Turn off Light" to "Turn off light" when turning off the lights, ensuring consistency.
 Car Fix: Fixed a bug where if the Auto Car Engine option was "On" for the participant, the parking brakes would not release whenever the player got in the car unless the participant pressed the Space button. 
 Clothing Store Fixes:
 In the dressing room, the character will now stand where it should. 
 Prevented from being used by two people at the same time.

 Light Switch Save System: Fixed the issue where light switch and light connections were not saved with the save system. These connections are now properly saved.
 Stuttering Problem: Fixed a bug where pressing the CTRL key would cause the participating player to get stutter while moving.
 Motion Sickness Sync: Fixed an out of sync issue between the participating player and the server during wall painting when the Motion Sickness option is enabled for the participating player.
 Trash Location Fix: Fixed the location of trash items that spawn underground at the office.[/olist]

Patch Notes: Version 0.0.8

Greetings, Contractors! Version 0.0.8 is live!

We've been hard at work addressing several bugs and improving gameplay based on your feedback. Here’s what’s been fixed in this update:

Bug Fixes:

1. Motion Sickness Wall Painting: Resolved an issue where wall paintings were not being counted in single-player mode. Additionally, the grid appearing when loading a saved game has been fixed.
2. Base Management Customizations: Fixed an issue where customizations needed to be purchased twice for the UI to update correctly. Now, one purchase will properly reflect in the UI.
3. Window Cleaning Issue: Resolved a bug where holding the mouse button and switching between dirty windows caused the windows not to be cleaned by either the server or the client.
4. Ottoman (Bedroom Seat) Placement: Corrected the inconsistency in placing the ottoman in the bedroom, ensuring proper placement every time.
5. Exterior Cladding Collision: Addressed the inconsistent collision issues with exterior cladding, making placements more reliable.
6. Stair Placement Issue: Fixed the bug where the stair ghost would disappear and prevent players from placing stairs after saving the game.
7. Joshua Decorate Mission: Fixed an issue where the extract objective was not being counted when the furniture was packaged during Joshua's decorate mission.
8. Notebook Placement: Fixed inconsistencies with notebook placement, ensuring it works as intended.
9. Light Switch Connection Mode: Addressed an issue where interactions were disabled when in light-light switch connection mode.
10. Bathroom Cabinets: Bathroom cabinets are now properly recognized for design points, ensuring they contribute to your overall design score.
11. Generator and Vehicle Bug: Resolved an issue where carrying a generator and walking into a T5 or other vehicles could cause them to bug out and either fly across the map or get stuck under the map.
12. Door Reversal on Save: Fixed a bug where saving or autosaving the game would cause the door of a room to be replaced with its reverse version. The door will now remain in its correct orientation after saving.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Please keep sharing your thoughts with us, and enjoy the improvements!

notes.title: ContractVille 0.0.2 Update
